_comment: Curated freely distributable games. 'bundled' entries ship in content/ with their license; others are links only - the hub never downloads or redistributes them automatically. License details: docs/research/games-and-licenses.md.

libbet.title: Libbet and the Magic Floor
libbet.description: Roll a ball across a puzzle floor, lighting every tile. Built from source (commit 1232e71) with RGBDS 0.9.4.
